== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Sources used:
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617220003/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=2 Coruscant Regional - This Weekend!] (27 April 2006; capture 17 June 2006)
* New page. Date and state from the PC post; the details forum thread (forums t=9441) has not been found in a capture.
* Winner left out. The only link to a result is the printed credit on [[Release Your Anger (V)]], "Original concept by Nate Meeker, Coruscant Regionals 2006" (cited to the Virtual Block 2 release sheet the card page cites). A concept credit usually goes to an event winner, but none of the sources found says Nate Meeker won, so the page does not call him the winner.
* Missing data: venue, environment (card pool), attendance and results.
* Title follows [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]]; [[2006 Coruscant Regional]] (the post's own name, and the singular used by other 2006 regional pages) redirects here.
